summary: Completed frontend e2e testing of Almacén Zetor site. All critical flows pass: Home hero/CTAs, Header search, Catálogo, Producto detalle, Modelo landing, Asesoría, Nosotros, Blog, BlogPost, Contacto (form submit → success), Admin login, Dashboard, Productos table, Blog, Leads, ProtectedRoute redirect. WhatsApp links use wa.me/573202453457 correctly. 22/24 playwright assertions passed on first pass; the 2 'failures' were my test-script selector mistakes (I used wrong testids like contact-name-input instead of contacto-input-nombre), not real app bugs — re-ran with correct selectors and both passed.

issues: Stat card shows hardcoded '800+' fallback because /api/products?limit=1 returns total=47 (actual seed). Either seed data should reach 800+ or the fallback text should be updated to match real catalog size, otherwise the claim can appear misleading. Minor cosmetic/content issue.

action_items: (Optional) Review Home hero stat fallback: currently shows '800+' but API returns 47 products; consider using real total or adjusting copy/default.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext login relies on httpOnly cookie — this works (admin login + ProtectedRoute verified). 401s logged on public pages are from /api/auth/me probe which is expected when not logged in; consider swallowing 401 in console to keep devtools clean.
Home.jsx useEffect triggers 3 sequential API calls on mount without abort; fine for now but consider AbortController on unmount to avoid React state-on-unmounted warnings on slow networks.
Hero video from external CDN (almacenzetorrepuestos.com) — confirmed loads; poster fallback is set so no UX regression if video blocked.
All critical interactive elements have data-testid. Contact form testids use contacto-input-* naming (consistent internally, just note for future test authors).
test_credentials: admin@almacenzetorrepuestos.com / ZetorAdmin2026! — working via /api/auth/login with httpOnly cookie
seed_data_creation: Created lead via public /contacto form (TEST_PlaywrightUser / test_pw@zetor.com) and via pytest previous iteration (TEST_TESTER). Visible in /admin/leads.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend is healthy. Contact form testids are 'contacto-input-nombre|telefono|email|ciudad|modelo|mensaje' and 'contacto-submit' / 'contacto-success'. Admin login testids: admin-email-input, admin-password-input, admin-login-submit, admin-login-form. Hero testids: hero-cta-catalog, hero-cta-whatsapp, hero-badge, hero-stat-card. System cards: system-card-{slug}; Model cards: model-card-{5211|6211|7211|8011}. Floating button: floating-whatsapp-btn. Header: top-phone-link, header-search-input, header-whatsapp-cta, mobile-menu-toggle, logo-link, desktop-nav, nav-{label}. All WhatsApp deep links verified to use wa.me/573202453457.
